description:
No source or test file carries a requirement identifier belonging to a container other than its own.

## Background

`crates/jit/tests/fast_docs_templates/ai_review_verdict_tests.rs` opens with a `(REQ-11)` tag. Requirement identifiers are issue-local: `REQ-11` names a requirement of a different epic, so the tag points at a contract this file does not implement.

A stale identifier of this kind survives because nothing reads it — which is also why it misleads: a reader tracing coverage follows it to the wrong container.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The tag names the requirement this file actually covers, or is removed.
- [hard] REQ-02: A sweep of the crate's sources and tests reports no other requirement identifier attributed to a container that does not own the file, and the sweep's result is stated.
title: Remove the requirement tag naming another container
